Modified selection: lowercase English headwords matching the game's accepted
4–7-letter vocabulary; up to four entries and four senses per entry; preserve
sense labels. Quotations, examples, media and other fields are omitted. Display
formatting is removed and long meanings may be shortened. No inferred meanings.
Exact per-entry revisions are not supplied by this extract. Source data can have
errors and incomplete coverage. Reproduction: scripts/import-local-definitions.py;
pinned counts, hashes and transformations: src/data/definitions/source.json.

This data license is separate from the application code license. No endorsement
by Wiktionary, Wikimedia, Kaikki or Wiktextract is implied.
